// Fixture guarding against false positives: a domain package using only the standard library and
// its own module's internal packages must produce no violations.
package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"time"

	_ "github.com/gitfrok/backend/modules/repository/internal/domain"
)

var ErrNotFound = errors.New("not found")

type Ref struct {
	Name      string
	UpdatedAt time.Time
}
